social.search.description: Search content across Instagram, Threads, and Facebook, including the user's own posts and activity. Use post_url for a direct lookup of one exact post URL instead of translating the link into a query. Ranking intent: informational (default), engagement, or recency. Results come back with the writing system searched in first; posts in a different script sit below a marked line.
